notes: whom is given to the object suffix of בָּחַר־בּוֹ under rule 18 and the בְּ is left unrepresented under rule 40; the competing reading would fuse preposition and suffix, but the ASV writes no pronominal adverb here.
yet is marked added; a reading that folds it into נַעַר as still a youth was available, but is young already carries the lexeme and no morpheme writes the temporal shade (rule 30).
is for man is read as rule 49's prepositional predicate, discontinuous around the negative under rule 25.
